tldr: Mars in Taurus: action is steady, stubborn, and slow to redirect.
body: With Mars in Taurus, drive builds through persistence, endurance, and physical effort. Mars is in detriment here, so force can feel slow or stuck until desire is fully engaged.
gift: Stamina, follow-through, practical effort, and the ability to keep going.
challenge: Inertia, passive aggression, and digging in after the plan has stopped working.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
